note: One task instance, one artifact. The five shipped files are the ipo-tm-004 worker artifact 2c1dade2913d0a8b... (gate 1.5.0, 45/45 checks on the full artifact, exact-byte --accepted on the worker and re-accepted in jobs ipo-tm-baseline-001, ipo-tm-diag-001 and ipo-tm-diag-002); the package's code/ carries the construction script, the references implementation, the runner-workdir materializer and the gate, baseline/ the runner-contract baseline. The holdout ships as an asset like the other splits; it is not copied into any runner workdir and was never evaluated. The publisher exposes exactly one frozen snapshot and no historical vintages, so the evaluation contract declares retrospective research over the pinned snapshot (event_time filing instant, training-label timing unverified), never a point-in-time reconstruction. Recorded finding carried in measurements.json, RELEASE_NOTES.md and VERIFICATION.md: the stock runner baseline (eval AUC 0.6224) exceeds every measured simple reference on the identical 97,274 eval rows with paired row-level intervals excluding zero (mark-type rate 0.5650, nice-class rate 0.5421, calendar 0.4972) - demonstrated headroom over these references under this protocol, with its scope recorded beside it (row-level intervals only, one model configuration, two filing years of eval); no figure may be quoted without that comparison beside it.
